matches.rationale: Pred_1 discusses Theorem 3.1 and Table 1, focusing on the adversarial reward violating the uncertainty set condition '~r ≯ r'. GT_2 describes Theorem 3.3 as incorrectly claiming guarantees with oversimplified arguments and missing key assumptions. Both point to the same theorem having fundamental logical/formal problems, satisfying R1 (same locus) and R4 (concrete defect).

Pred_3 criticizes Theorem 4.1's proof as insufficient, noting it uses a trivial constant-reward case without supporting the general claim. GT_3 states the proof relies on a simplistic symmetrization with constant rewards and overstates impossibility without addressing loopholes. Both identify the same defect in the same theorem's proof logic, satisfying R1 and R4.
